title: L - the same tickets in English and Chinese
doc_ref: docs.typesafe.ai/concepts/state - 'other languages, including CJK scripts, are accepted but currently have lower accuracy'
note: Eight tickets written twice, once in English and once in Chinese, under two question sets. Three conditions come out of it: English content with English questions as the baseline, Chinese content with English questions, which is what a Chinese-language product most easily builds, and Chinese content with fully Chinese questions. The docs state the accuracy is lower without saying by how much, and the answer decides whether it is worth translating content before sending it. The Chinese variant also renames its options, which the alias table maps back so the two question sets stay comparable.
